raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 card collector, rolling out since 2026-01-16, emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy rows and all history are in America/Chicago local time. This shifts v2 transactions 6 hours later: evening transactions spill into 00:00-06:00 and onto 2026-01-19, which produces the volume and time-distribution alerts. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to Chicago local time restores consistency; the sample confirms it, since v2 12:03 UTC becomes 06:03 local, in line with legacy openings around 06:0x.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) s WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
